About Boy & Dragon: In a boundless notebook world lives a brave young knight and his oafish pet Dragon. Together, Boy and Dragon go on bizarre adventures and wreak magical mayhem, all the while avoiding the wrath of the Evil Wizard. With Boy’s brilliant brains and Dragon’s bumbling brawn, the pair fly through turning pages to triumph in a tale of true camaraderie. Told through classic hand-drawn characters animation, Boy & Dragon provides laughs for all ages in a playful world that transcends the limits of traditional storytelling. Boy & Dragon is a brand new cartoon using the frame-by-frame traditional hand drawn technique of animation.
